mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, quantity, flavor, create_time, update_time FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dish_id = #{dishId}
SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, quantity, flavor, create_time, update_time FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, quantity, flavor, create_time, update_time FROM shopping_cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart ( user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, quantity, flavor ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{dishId}, #{setmealId}, #{quantity}, #{flavor} )
mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, COALESCE(sc.dish_id, sc.setmeal_id) AS product_id, CASE WHEN sc.dish_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'dish' ELSE 'setmeal' END AS product_type, COALESCE(d.name, s.name) AS name, COALESCE(d.image, s.image) AS image, COALESCE(d.price, s.price) AS unit_price, sc.quantity, sc.flavor FROM shopping_cart sc LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = sc.dish_id LEFT JOIN setmeal s ON s.id = sc.setmeal_id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sc.create_time ASC, sc.id ASC
